proposal.reason: Main change is removing CollNet transport/plugin/proxy functionality and related backend state (`network`). Independently substantive changes also remove CollNet device-kernel implementations while keeping the reserved algorithm slot (`kernels`), remove CollNet logical graph construction/connection (`graph-search`) and CollNet-specific NIC/topology capability discovery fields (`device-topology`), and update built-in selection/runtime planning plus external tuner callback handling so CollNet (slot 2) is reserved/unsupported and invalid tuner IDs fall back to internal tuning (`tuning`, `enqueue`, `tuner-plugin`).
